summary: Evidence writer + merge watch: Jira/PR/Confluence templates, PR state polling
epic_summary: WS-E Integrations (Jira, Confluence, GitHub push/PR/checks/merge, Sonar, intake, web search)
description:
Due 2026-11-07.

* `github_pr_state(pr)` (open/merged/closed, review comments) for the runtime's merge watch; on merge the runtime calls `jira_transition(key, "Done")` (no webhook).
* Templates as functions: PR body (root cause, change, tests, evidence, run link), Jira evidence comment, Confluence evidence page in RTKB (title `<KEY> evidence: <summary>`), handoff note.
* `confluence_write` space allowlist (from review of #2).

## Acceptance

A dry run renders all four templates from a recorded run record; live write to RTKB works.
